verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his Infernal Chains and Darkin Blade before level 6; you claw the lane back by farming through cooldown windows and threatening executes once Demacian Justice resets fast.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's kit is built around forcing fights on his terms — Infernal Chains (W) drags you into range, Umbral Dash (E) both closes gaps and heals him off your champion, and Deathbringer Stance empowers an auto that punishes any prolonged trade. Garen has no way to interrupt that chain from range, so the entire lane is about denying him free W pulls and Q swings rather than out-trading him head-on. The 43.5% win rate over 170 games and OP.GG's own defensive read confirm this is Aatrox's lane to lose, not yours to force.

theirWindow.what: He can pull you with Infernal Chains, heal off the E (Umbral Dash) passive, and land Deathbringer Stance's empowered auto on you almost for free. Give ground and let the wave push instead of standing in his 825-range W.

yourWindow.when: his W is on visible cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without Infernal Chains he has no way to force range onto you. Walk up, farm with E (Judgment), and use Q (Decisive Strike)'s move speed and silence to punish any Umbral Dash engage attempt.

powerCurve.note: Neither W nor Q are threatening yet
Infernal Chains online, solo-kill window opens
World Ender adds AD, heal, fear

start.why: Runs in 63.2% of games at 42.6% win rate — the flat damage reduction and regen directly counter Aatrox's Q pokes and Deathbringer Stance procs while you wait out his cooldowns.

boots.why: 70.4% pick rate at 45.4% win rate; attack speed helps you actually punish the short windows his W and E are down instead of trading raw damage.

core.why: First item in the top build path (53.1% win rate over 32 games); the active slow lets you stick on him once his Umbral Dash is spent.
Second in the same path — attack speed and move speed keep pace with his dash-heavy kit.
Closes out the core path; grievous wounds cuts directly into Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing.

situational.when: he is out-healing your trades through his passive and E sooner than expected
you get ahead in kills and need more tempo to punish his down cooldowns across the map
you need more raw survivability and waveclear to hold the lane defensively

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking Conqueror sustains you through the extended fights Aatrox wants, so his Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash heals aren't the only sustain on the trade — it also complements Perseverance once you've stabilized health.

summoners.why: Run in 96.7% of games at 45.6% win rate; Ignite denies both Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing on any trade you commit to, which is the difference-maker in a lane where he out-heals you by default.

playing.title: Track his W cooldown all lane
playing.detail: Infernal Chains is 20/18/16/14/12s on cooldown and 825 range. When it's down he has no way to force range onto you — that's your window to farm freely or trade in.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed W immediately
playing.detail: If he misses Infernal Chains, use Decisive Strike's move speed burst to close and land the silence before he can reset the fight with Umbral Dash.

playing.title: Don't trade through all three Q swings
playing.detail: The Darkin Blade can hit up to three times with a different area each swing. Take one or two swings and disengage rather than standing through the full combo.

playing.title: Play for the wave at level 6
playing.detail: World Ender grants him AD, extra healing, and move speed the moment it comes online — treat levels 6-8 as his kill window and avoid standing in melee range near turret.

playing.title: Farm safe, don't force trades
playing.detail: OP.GG's own data gives him both the lane and solo-kill edge here. Prioritize safe CS with Judgment's spin over contesting every trade he offers.

playing.title: Save your silence for his empowered auto
playing.detail: Landing Decisive Strike's silence while Deathbringer Stance is up denies both the bonus magic damage and the healing from that auto in the same trade.

playing.title: Look for executes once R resets fast
playing.detail: Demacian Justice starts at a brutal 140s cooldown but drops to 20s by level 16. Once you're rank 5, threaten every time he's near execute range instead of waiting for a full engage.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, runes, summoner spells, and every win-rate/sample figure above come from measured games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG — nothing there is estimated. The mechanical reasoning, cooldown-tracking calls, and lane-phase breakdown are my own analysis built on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Maintain your distance from Aatrox considering the range of his abilities. Purchase Bramble Vest and focus on farming until his abilities are on cooldown to fight him.
